original21.english: I insist on eating the same foods or at the same time every day.
original21.chinese: 我坚持每天吃相同的食物，或者每天在相同的时间吃饭。

original21.english: I become frustrated or upset if things don't go to plan.
original21.chinese: 如果事情没有按计划进行，我会感到沮丧或烦躁。

original21.english: I can modify my plans when there is a change in circumstances (e.g., change of time or venue, unexpected weather, something is unavailable).
original21.chinese: 情况发生变化时，我能够调整自己的计划（例如时间或地点改变、天气突变，或者原定需要的东西无法使用）。

original21.english: I feel anxious or stressed when faced with unfamiliar situations or people.
original21.chinese: 面对不熟悉的情况或人时，我会感到焦虑或压力。

original21.english: I have specific routines related to my meals/food (e.g. needing to sit in the same spot, use the same cutlery).
original21.chinese: 我在吃饭方面有固定的习惯（例如必须坐在同一个位置、使用同一套餐具）。

original21.english: I can easily change my approach to a task if shown a better way.
original21.chinese: 如果有人告诉我做某项任务有更好的方法，我能轻松改变自己的做法。

original21.english: I often repeat particular words or phrases in exactly the same way (e.g., catchphrases).
original21.chinese: 我经常以完全相同的方式重复某些词语或短句（例如口头禅）。

original21.english: I like to follow specific routines when I leave the house (e.g., always taking the same route, always being dropped off at the same spot).
original21.chinese: 离家外出时，我喜欢遵循固定的习惯（例如总走同一条路，或总在同一个地点下车）。

original21.english: I have to be right, even if it means not listening to others’ opinions.
original21.chinese: 我认为自己必须是对的，即使这意味着不听别人的意见。

original21.english: I expect others to uphold the same ideas, values, and beliefs as mine.
original21.chinese: 我希望别人也坚持与我相同的观点、价值观和信念。

original21.english: I need to repeat some actions/tasks until they feel “just right”.
original21.chinese: 我需要反复做某些动作或任务，直到觉得“恰到好处”为止。

original21.english: I find it hard to let go of my ideas or beliefs, even when presented with new information.
original21.chinese: 即使得到了新的信息，我也很难放下原有的想法或信念。

original21.english: I feel like I need to repeat certain actions (e.g., pacing, tapping, checking).
original21.chinese: 我觉得自己必须重复某些动作（例如来回踱步、敲击或反复检查）。

original21.english: I get overly focused on small details even when it’s not helpful to do so.
original21.chinese: 即使关注细节没有帮助，我也会过度关注一些小细节。

original21.english: I repetitively count and/or order objects in my environment.
original21.chinese: 我会反复清点或排列周围的物品。

original21.english: When interrupted, I can easily switch back to what I was previously doing.
original21.chinese: 被打断后，我能够轻松回到之前正在做的事情上。

original21.english: I prefer it when people behave in a specific way or according to a set of rules during activities.
original21.chinese: 在活动中，我更希望别人以特定方式行事，或者按照一套规则行动。

original21.english: I can easily adapt to changes in the topic of conversation.
original21.chinese: 谈话话题发生变化时，我能够轻松适应。

original21.english: I have specific interests in items or objects that others find unusual.
original21.chinese: 我对某些物品有特别的兴趣，而别人觉得这些物品很不寻常。

original21.english: I can adapt my behaviour according to the social situation (e.g., casual versus formal settings)
original21.chinese: 我能够根据不同的社交场合调整自己的行为（例如非正式场合与正式场合）。

original21.english: I am very unsettled by last-minute changes to my plans.
original21.chinese: 如果我的计划在最后一刻发生变化，我会感到很不安。
